about: Relay conformance cases: requests and what both relays answer. Battle's formiga-battle-room keeps the original (tests/conformance/relay-cases.json) and runs it against the reference relay; the Formiga site keeps a byte-identical copy (tests/fixtures/relay-cases.json) and runs it against its relay. Change it in Battle, then copy it to the site. Times are milliseconds on the relay's clock; 'as' is the side making the request; 'view' paths are dotted (a number picks from a list, 'length' counts one), and null matches a field left out.

cases.name: a turn locks once both plans are in, and both see the same locked plans
a side with no orders three turns running forfeits
both sides away at once call the match off, and neither forfeits
once a side reports the match ended no more turns lock, and the friend's late board still confirms it
a side that reported the match ended may leave without forfeiting

steps.note: both have seen the end, so the room is gone

cases.name: a side that leaves before reporting the match ended forfeits
a side that never reports how the match ended forfeits once the wait is over
the same board ended for one window and not the other is out of step
every kind of order Battle sends is a plan, passed on as Battle reads it
a plan Battle could not read is malformed
a team Battle could not read is malformed, and the room still waits for the friend
